note: golden_hash filled by golden-parity.test.mjs --update. tax_year is a REQUIRED input; PARAMS carries the 2025 ($176,100) and 2026 ($184,500) OASDI contribution and benefit bases and an unsupported year fails closed. The SS/Medicare rates and the $200,000 Additional Medicare threshold are statutory and not year-keyed. Vector 1 (the proven vector) is the defect this rebuild closes: a 2026 payroll at $180,000 YTD, which the 2025 base treated as fully exhausted.

vectors.name: band_2026_ss_wage_base_recovered
vectors.description: tax_year 2026, $5,000 gross, $180,000 YTD FICA wages before this period - inside the $176,100-$184,500 band. Against the 2026 base of $184,500 there is $4,500 of room remaining, which is less than the $5,000 gross, so $4,500 is SS-taxable and SS_WAGE_BASE_REACHED flags: 4500*0.062 = $279.00. Under the 2025 base this period returned $0.00 SS tax for both the employee and the matching employer share.

output_payload.regulatory_basis: IRC 3101/3121 (FICA); SSA 2026 Contribution and Benefit Base ($184,500 OASDI wage base); IRC 3101(b)(2) Additional Medicare Tax ($200,000 employer-withholding threshold).
output_payload.note: Federal FICA and net pay only; not tax advice. State/local withholding and state disability/unemployment employee contributions out of scope. federal_withholding_per_period is a declared input (e.g. from compute_federal_withholding, which must be called with the same tax_year), not recomputed here.

vectors.name: standard_below_thresholds_2026
vectors.description: tax_year 2026, $3,000 gross, $200 pretax 401(k)/HSA (FICA+FIT exempt), $300 federal withholding (declared input), $50 post-tax deduction, $10,000 YTD FICA wages - well under both the $184,500 SS wage base and the $200,000 Additional Medicare threshold. FICA wages = $2,800. SS = 2800*0.062 = $173.60. Medicare = 2800*0.0145 = $40.60.

output_payload.regulatory_basis: IRC 3101/3121 (FICA); SSA 2026 Contribution and Benefit Base ($184,500 OASDI wage base); IRC 3101(b)(2) Additional Medicare Tax ($200,000 employer-withholding threshold).
